content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Fire and life-safety contracting services for buildings; RPM sells coatings, sealants and roofing materials, not safety installation services."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Wood products manufacturing and lumber distribution; no overlap with RPM's coatings, sealants or roofing systems."},{"label":"C3","good":true,"reason":"Roofing membranes, roof coatings and building envelope products sold to roofing contractors and distributors, matching RPM's roofing business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Utility metering, grid communication, test equipment and aerospace components; unrelated to RPM's coatings and building products."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Plumbing, HVAC and waterworks distributor; RPM manufactures coatings and roofing systems rather than distributing trade products."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Roofing products and insulation sold to roofing contractors and home centers, overlapping RPM's roofing and building materials, though shingles differ from coatings."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Paints, coatings, sealants and architectural paints sold to contractors and retailers, closely matching RPM's coatings and consumer paint lines."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Industrial process fluids, metalworking chemicals and lubricants for plants; differs from RPM's construction and consumer coatings."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Locks, latches, hinges and metal components sold to equipment makers; no overlap with RPM's coatings or roofing businesses."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Coding printers, inks and water quality instruments for manufacturers and utilities; different products and customers from RPM."}]}
